title: Homicide Hunter: Lt. Joe Kenda
description:
S07 E05 — Rearview Mirror
When a retired military man runs over a pedestrian, it's up to Lt. Joe Kenda to determine if the accident was the result of bad brakes or bad intent; a shooting in a dive bar leads to a quick arrest, but Kenda can't shake feelings of unease.

title: Homicide Hunter: Lt. Joe Kenda
description:
S07 E11 — Lockdown
When a crazed gunman terrorizes his neighborhood, officers put themselves in the line of fire to restore order; a man discovers his elderly father has been stabbed in the back, and the knife itself turns out to be Lt. Joe Kenda's biggest clue.

title: Homicide Hunter: Lt. Joe Kenda
description:
S06 E14 — Metal on Metal
A star athlete is gunned down just weeks before starting college, leaving his family heartbroken and detectives stumped; Lt. Joe Kenda pries into the victim's personal life and learns more about his last night on Earth.

title: Homicide Hunter: Lt. Joe Kenda
description:
S06 E16 — Shattered
After two teenagers discover a lifeless body in the street, Lt. Joe Kenda must determine whether the killer was a jealous lover or an unhinged individual; then, Kenda turns to a forensic expert to see if a young mother hanged herself.

title: On the Case With Paula Zahn
description:
S21 E04 — When, Where and Who?
When a 15-year-old girl vanishes from her front porch, police must uncover when she was last seen, where she might have been going and who would have wanted her dead.

title: On the Case With Paula Zahn
description:
S22 E03 — A Blue Raincoat
After a young girl disappears on her way home from school, police find her blue raincoat 30 miles away, which marks the start of a heartbreaking homicide investigation.

title: On the Case With Paula Zahn
description:
S21 E09 — A Storm of Rage
A beautiful young mother vanishes just hours before the deadliest hurricane in Texas history; the investigation forces her loved ones to weather a storm and then survive a tempest.

title: People Magazine Investigates
description:
The Secrets of the Twelve Tribes Cult
Religious leader Gene Spriggs creates a movement in Tennessee with teenagers and disenchanted hippies called the Twelve Tribes; the Tribes become a cult with accusations of child abuse, forced labor and a devotion to what they claim is God's will.

title: Signs of a Psychopath
description:
S06 E06 — I Still Care About Her
A killer shoots a young woman dead in her boyfriend's Orlando, Fla., apartment; hours later, he turns up in a hospital bed 500 miles away with a gunshot wound and a bizarre story that unravels to reveal he's a lying, callous psychopath.

title: Signs of a Psychopath
description:
S06 E08 — An Excuse to Kill Somebody
A New Hampshire town reels after police arrest four teenagers for robbing and murdering a 42-year-old mother and maiming her 11-year-old daughter; detectives uncover two suspects with the characteristics of sadistic psychopaths.

title: Signs of a Psychopath
description:
S05 E08 — Ladies First
When a beloved elderly couple disappears on a Sunday afternoon, one person knows their battered bodies lie dead at the bottom of a well; that man is the couple's son, who lives off his parents' charity yet takes pleasure in murdering them.

title: Signs of a Psychopath
description:
S05 E02 — I Was in a Zone
A crash on a North Dakota highway leaves one passenger dead but the driver unscathed; when investigators see that the victim has stab wounds, they know there was foul play; detectives interrogate the driver.

title: Signs of a Psychopath
description:
S05 E06 — I Wanted Her to Hear It
A man finds his girlfriend and her mother murdered in their beds at night; he calls 911 for help, but police discover his urge to seek revenge.

title: Signs of a Psychopath
description:
S05 E09 — In My Van, I'm the Aggressor
When Omaha, Neb., police officers arrest the driver of a stolen van, he shocks detectives by giving an unsolicited confession to a gruesome murder, and it is only the first of many chilling revelations.

title: Evil Lives Here
description:
S10 E07 — I Want to Watch His Last Breath
Cathy Mills is only a teenager when her fairy-tale marriage to Robert Walden turns into a nightmare; still, it is not until she sees a police sketch of her husband that she realizes his true identity.

title: Evil Lives Here
description:
S09 E02 — My Son Is Damaged Goods
After finding her name on a bullet, a woman fears her son has lethal plans.

title: Evil Lives Here
description:
S10 E01 — My Son Should Die in Prison
Jon Eason hopes every day that someone will murder his son Dylan in prison; Dylan Eason's life sentence without parole doesn't appease his father, who admits wishing for his own son's death is horrible but feels Dylan deserves it for his 2016 crimes.

title: Evil Lives Here
description:
S10 E02 — He Got Into My Soul
Christian Fuhr receives a life sentence, and his girlfriend, Ammie Turos, believes he is innocent; when she discovers he's guilty, her conviction is replaced by uncertainty, and she wonders if her life had been in danger the entire time.

title: Evil Lives Here
description:
S09 E05 — They Said I Killed My Brother
When Eric Nance asks his sister, Belinda, to find and destroy a murder weapon, he expects her to protect him; when Belinda finds it, she is torn between family loyalty and doing what she knows to be right.

title: Evil Lives Here
description:
S10 E03 — Why Did I Let Him In?
A woman is flattered by her boyfriend's obsession, until he turns violent.

title: Evil Lives Here
description:
S19 E05 — They All Saw His Evil
A recently divorced woman meets a kind, caring, and nurturing father. Despite her reservations against getting into a new relationship, she falls in love. However, she doesn't see what everyone else around her sees - that he is a killer.

title: Evil Lives Here: My Child the Killer
description:
S01 E02 — A Father's Pain
A dad learns his son is behind three murders across Oregon and California; confronted with a truth he never imagined, Ken makes the choice to call authorities and turn in his own son, a decision that shatters their relationship forever.

title: A Body in the Basement
description:
S03 E05 — A Secret Burden
Late one summer night in 2011, a mysterious man walks into a police station in Lewiston, Maine, accusing his best friend of murder. When his friend claims he is the actual killer, detectives must determine who is telling the truth.

title: Evil Lives Here
description:
S18 E09 — Mother's Day Malice
As a child, Deon knows her stepfather, Edward, is deeply controlling; he instills fear into the family with his rage fits; after Deon's mother finally leaves him, Edward tries to regain control of the family with a plan to eliminate them all.

title: Evil Lives Here
description:
S01 E04 — The Prophet
Kevin Currie is a devout follower of spiritual leader Jeffrey Lundgren, when he comes to realize Lundgren is really a devil in disguise who has hatched an evil plan.

title: American Monster
description:
S07 E05 — What the Heart Wants
Raised in a big Mormon family, Ashlee Harmon grows up wanting that same kind of lifestyle; she marries her college boyfriend, Emmett Corrigan, and raises five kids while he opens his own law firm, but dirty secrets soon trigger a deadly showdown.

title: American Monster
description:
S08 E08 — Put Yourself Out There
As gentle giant Randy Ferguson approaches his 40th birthday, his sisters worry that he'll never have a family of his own; that all changes when Randy meets single mom Angela Phillips; but the beautiful life they build together hides an ugly secret.

title: American Monster
description:
S07 E09 — It Could Be Me
Michelle Lira dreams of being a doctor, until one day a rollercoaster romance steers her life in a different direction, straight into a deadly ambush.

title: American Monster
description:
S07 E02 — He Was Her Everything
In Hudson, Wis., Charlene and Darrell Wold seem to be living a blissful existence with their blended family; they do all they can to keep their household safe and secure, but they never imagined the real danger would come from within.

title: American Monster
description:
S08 E09 — When's Mom Coming Home?
Joann Albanese finds love again with a personal trainer named John Edwards, then John moves in but Joann discovers that her new boyfriend isn't who he claims to be.

title: American Monster
description:
S07 E06 — Stage Fright
Stephanie is a gifted stage performer and much-loved teacher; behind closed doors, resentment and envy fester in her marriage, leading to a shocking 911 call.

title: Murder Calls
description:
S01 E04 — The Dark Horse
A woman returns home to find her husband unconscious and bleeding on the floor of their horse barn; a 911 operator coaches her through CPR, but it's too late, and police later use the call itself to find clues to a plot to kill a beloved father.

title: 911: Did the Killer Call
description:
S01 E06 — Lover Or Liar
A wife is killed while calling 911 and her husband is shot in the leg; he claims it was an intruder, but the police have their doubts.

title: 911: Did the Killer Call
description:
S01 E02 — Clues to Murder
A woman falls to her death in the Rockies, her husband calls 911; the police must find out whether her death was really an accident or was she pushed; a three-year-old is found dead in a river; her father calls 911, he becomes the prime suspect.

title: 911: Did the Killer Call
description:
S01 E01 — Suspect #1
Three horrific murders. Three different 911 calls. All three callers claim they're innocent - but for the police, the call can reveal so much more than just the facts of the case. Find out which of them is the real killer in disguise.

title: Body Cam
description:
S07 E05 — Failure to Comply
In Florida, a father kidnaps his own child; a wanted fugitive in Georgia fires six shots at a police officer, igniting panic in the neighborhood; in Ohio, a suspect attempts to evade police by escaping into a kids' day care center.

title: Body Cam
description:
S06 E09 — Breathe
In New Mexico, officers chasing a robbery suspect go down in a hail of bullets from a heavily armed suspect; in Ohio, a father threatens to blow up his children and an entire neighborhood with over 25,000 pounds of explosives.

title: Body Cam
description:
S06 E06 — Catch Me!
In California, a body in the woods triggers a high-speed chase; the search for a reckless Utah motorcyclist complicates when he steals a squad car with access to the guns; in Illinois, officers race to save a couple trapped in their burning home.

title: Body Cam
description:
S07 E02 — Into the Darkness
In Washington state, an off-duty officer spots a wanted criminal in an elementary school; officers in Georgia chase a woman on a rampage in her car; in Florida, a stolen car crashes, and the suspect flees into an alligator-infested marsh.

title: Body Cam
description:
S07 E04 — Don't Let Me Die
Wisconsin officers cautiously approach a reckless driver's wrecked car who refuses to exit the vehicle and opens fire on them; in Washington state, a community rallies to protect two officers shot in the line of duty.

title: Body Cam
description:
S06 E10 — Split Second
In Florida, police tracking carjackers find themselves pursuing two separate suspects; a home invasion in Michigan takes a turn when the suspect takes the homeowners and their child hostage and opens fire on officers.

description:
The Mystery In Room 460
With a dorm full of college girls, tensions can run high. However, when one of them ends up brutally murdered, all are under suspicion.

Two old friends reconnect when they end up renting a house together from an absentee landlord; familiarity quickly turns into frustration, and an abusive relationship escalates to a violent death.

description:
S02 E05 — The Devil's Ranch
After a college student goes missing while on spring break, authorities work around the clock to find him; then the investigation takes a grisly turn into the world of drug smuggling, the occult and human sacrifice.

title: Pandora's Box: Unleashing Evil
description:
S02 E09 — A Murder She Wrote
An Iowa mother gets hailed a hero when she shoots an intruder in her home, but as the case evolves, investigators learn a very different truth; detectives face off against a master manipulator hell-bent on revenge at any cost.

title: Pandora's Box: Unleashing Evil
description:
S02 E08 — Homicide on the Range
A man's disappearance in Virginia comes to the attention of authorities and ignites a multi-jurisdictional investigation; a routine inquiry into the missing man's finances reveals a heartless killer with a checkered past.

title: Deadly Women
description:
S14 E13 — Making a Killing
Women who commit crimes out of greed.

title: Deadly Women
description:
S14 E12 — Clean Hands, Dirty Deeds
Crime experts explore the motives and modus operandi of female killers; while males are often driven by anger, impulse and destruction, women usually have more complex, long-term reasons to kill.

title: Deadly Women
description:
S14 E10 — Soulless
Eyes are the windows to the soul, except for these three demented women.

title: Fatal Vows
description:
S05 E11 — A Thin Blue Line
High school sweethearts Linda and Derrick Yancey become sheriff's deputies with a picture-perfect marriage, then their marriage degenerates into a tale of good cop/bad cop ending in murder with one of them on the run.

title: Fatal Vows
description:
S05 E01 — Second Chance at Death
While mourning the death of his wife, Julian falls hard for his much-younger co-worker, Teresa; for a time, Teresa's spunk lifts Julian's spirits until a sordid affair plunges him into an abyss.

title: Fatal Vows
description:
S05 E03 — Blood and Sand
California beauty Pegye meets volleyball player Eric in Newport Beach, Calif.; with good looks and success, the couple appears to have it all, but hedonism comes at a price, and their dream life quickly becomes a waking nightmare.

title: Fatal Vows
description:
S05 E07 — Hell on Earth
A minister's son, Luther, falls hard for Anita, the daughter of a pastor; then, failure delivers a crushing blow to their relationship, turning their heavenly life into hell on Earth.

title: Fear Thy Neighbor
description:
S07 E08 — Bloodshed on Beattie Street
A former police chief gets into constant conflicts with a young renter who doesn't respect his authority; the war between them intensifies until blood flows down their street.

title: Fear Thy Neighbor
description:
S07 E07 — What's Mine Is Mine
A Virginia man insists, What's mine is mine, and what's yours is mine.

title: Fear Thy Neighbor
description:
S07 E12 — Law and Disorder
A former cop is moving into a close-knit neighborhood; conflict arises with the whole community over dogs, noise, and other disturbances that keep piling on and ratcheting up until a boiling point is reached, guns are drawn, and blood is spilled.

title: Fear Thy Neighbor
description:
S07 E13 — Sin City Shootout
On a quiet cul-de-sac, a contractor helps his neighbor rent the home beside him; unwittingly trapping himself between an increasingly unhinged presence on one side and the man's hostile parents on the other.

title: Fear Thy Neighbor
description:
S07 E06 — Old Friends, Bad Neighbors
Mixing business with pleasure spells murder for neighboring best friends.

title: Fear Thy Neighbor
description:
S07 E09 — Sour Grapes
Two women with a shared wall between their townhouses become increasingly volatile with each other; food fights, physical altercations and vandalism come to a bloody climax.

title: A Killer Among Friends
description:
S02 E01 — Secret Life of a Private Eye
When a woman disappears in Florida, her friends uncover a hidden life filled with new relationships and secrets. As investigators follow the trail, suspicion shifts toward someone in her inner circle who may know more than they admit.

title: Deadly Women 2.0
description:
S01 E01 — Malicious Moms
In Longmont, Colorado, a mother consumed by jealousy weaponizes her son to punish the ex who left her for her sister. In Gulf Breeze, Florida, a domestic dispute over child custody heats up and ends in murder.

title: Murder in Whitehouse
description: A 19-year-old nurse's aide heads out with a friend and never returns. As suspects emerge, investigators uncover a darker story of her final night.

title: Lethally Blonde
description:
S02 E07 — Burlesque and Blood
When the torso of a murdered French Quarter dancer washes up on a Mississippi beach, a community is driven to panic; to catch her killer, detectives must dive into the dark side of New Orleans, uncovering a world of sex, cults and ritual sacrifice.

description:
S03 E10 — Last Walk to Bad Creek
The discovery of the bullet-riddled bodies of Skyla Whitaker and Taylor Placker inspires panic among the community members of Weleetka, Okla.

title: Homicide Hunter: Lt. Joe Kenda
description:
S08 E16 — Who Took Heather?
A 13-year-old girl goes missing, sending Kenda's city into a panic; just when investigators think they've got a handle on what is going on, a cryptic letter to the district attorney's office suggests that the girl isn't the only victim.

title: Homicide Hunter: Lt. Joe Kenda
description:
S08 E06 — The Cage
Lt. Joe Kenda finds the bullet-ridden bodies of a middle-aged couple in a musty suburban house alongside the corpses of their two beloved pets; the case gets stuck in neutral until detectives discover an essential clue hidden behind a birdcage.

title: Homicide Hunter: Lt. Joe Kenda
description:
S08 E03 — .357 Magnum
The murder of a popular teenager at a crowded house party sends Lt. Joe Kenda down a winding road paved with lies, misdirection and innuendo; detectives use blood evidence to solve the shooting death of a firearms enthusiast.

title: Homicide Hunter: Lt. Joe Kenda
description:
S08 E20 — The Case That Haunts Me
A woman is found in the mountains, naked and covered in blood; Detective Joe Kenda's investigation leads him to uncover a world of violence and sexual fetishes, culminating in the most intense interrogation of his career.

title: Homicide Hunter: Lt. Joe Kenda
description:
S08 E17 — The Shoelace Killer
Teenagers find a woman's corpse while attending a party on the outskirts of the city; detectives quickly determine that the victim was strangled with her own shoelace, but they struggle to identify her.

title: Homicide Hunter: Lt. Joe Kenda
description:
S08 E14 — The Invisible Hand of Death
Two teenagers stumble upon a woman engulfed in flames, leaving detectives to wonder who was capable of this magnitude of cruelty; when a college student is strangled in his home, Lt. Joe Kenda must figure out which of his roommates is lying.

title: Murder in the Heartland
description:
S01 E02 — The Kind Sister
In Payette, Idaho, teacher Elizabeth Baune is the pillar of her community until she is stabbed to death in her own home; townspeople suspect Baune's kindness may have been behind her death.

title: Murder in the Heartland
description:
S01 E01 — Fear Travels Fast
In Aurora, Ind., the townspeople are horrified when beloved mother and hairstylist Leigh Jennings is killed in her own home.

title: Homicide Hunter: Lt. Joe Kenda
description:
S06 E05 — We Kill the Ones We Love
Lt. Joe Kenda must put his faith in a burglar to crack the case of a drive-by shooting; Cherie Bradley and her ex-boyfriend Anthony Carroll are found dead, and it's up to Kenda to discover which of their relatives did the deed.
